summary: check_readonly_account now reads policy.csv and every policy.*.csv key, refuses role:readonly-subject rules and holds the kubecoder binding across all keys; independently confirmed on in-memory renders (committed policy green, the three named widenings each red). One advisory finding: CSV-quoted subjects evade the naive split.

findings.summary: policy_lines splits on ',' without CSV unquoting, so a quoted "role:readonly"/"kubecoder" subject evades both refusals while Argo's csv loader enforces it
